items.text_th: เพิ่งกลับมาเล่นเกมนี้และเราก็มีปัญหาเกี่ยวกับการเติมเงินเราเติมเงินซื้อไอเทมในเกมไม่ได้
items.text_vn: Mới quay lại chơi game này và mình gặp vấn đề nạp tiền, không nạp tiền mua vật phẩm trong game được.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán
items.summary_vn: Báo không nạp tiền mua vật phẩm được sau khi quay lại
items.text_vn_machine: Phản hồi tiêu cực về việc nạp tiền, thanh toán hoặc nhận vật phẩm. Đây là tóm tắt phân loại; cần đối chiếu nguyên văn tiếng Thái.
items.text_en: Just came back to this game and I have a top-up problem, I can't top up to buy in-game items.
items.summary_en: Returning player can't top up to buy items.

items.text_th: เข้าไม่ได้ให้ลุงแต่บรรจงบัญชีพ่อปลดล็อคบัญชีก็ไม่เข้าไม่ได้เด้งกลับมาที่โหลด Appโอ๊ย
items.text_vn: Không vào được, nhờ chú làm giúp tài khoản của bố, mở khoá tài khoản rồi mà vẫn không vào được, cứ văng ngược về màn hình tải app. Trời ơi.
items.summary_vn: Mở khoá tài khoản rồi vẫn không vào được, bị văng về màn hình tải.
items.text_en: Can't get in. I asked my uncle to help with my dad's account, the account is unlocked but I still can't get in, it keeps kicking me back to the app loading screen. Oh my god.
items.summary_en: Account unlocked but still can't get in; kicked back to the loading screen.
Says the game is very good.

items.text_th: โหลดมาครั้งแรกคือแบบ อึ้งเลย คือมันสวยมากๆและยังมีคนช่วยสอน แนะนำทางอะไรอีกด้วย ทำได้หลายอย่างเลอออ ให้ไป4ดาวก้อนน้า
items.text_vn: Lần đầu tải về là kiểu sững người luôn, đẹp cực kỳ, lại còn có người hướng dẫn, chỉ đường các kiểu nữa. Làm được nhiều thứ lắm luôn. Cho 4 sao trước nha.
items.summary_vn: Người mới khen đồ họa đẹp, có hướng dẫn, nhiều hoạt động.
items.text_en: When I first downloaded it I was just stunned, it's gorgeous, and there's even someone guiding you and showing you the way. You can do so many things. Giving 4 stars for now.
items.summary_en: New player praises the graphics, tutorial and many activities.

items.text_th: เป็นเกมที่ห่วยที่สุดไม่สามารถเข้าเล่นได้หลังจากพยายามเล่นVNG รับรหัสมาเมื่อไม่กี่วินาทีบอกว่าโค้ดหมดอายุแล้วทั้งที่มันต้องใช้เวลาตั้ง 4 นาทีหลังจากนั้นก็ไม่สามารถเข้าเกมได้อีกเลย
items.text_vn: Game tệ nhất, không vào chơi được. Sau khi cố đăng nhập VNG, vừa nhận mã được vài giây đã báo mã hết hạn, trong khi phải đợi tới 4 phút. Sau đó thì không vào game được nữa luôn.
items.summary_vn: Mã đăng nhập VNG báo hết hạn ngay, không vào được game.
items.text_en: Worst game, can't get in. When I try to log in with VNG, a few seconds after getting the code it says the code expired, even though I'm supposed to wait 4 minutes. After that I couldn't get into the game at all.
items.summary_en: VNG login code expires immediately; can't get into the game.

items.text_th: เรยเล่นตอนเด็แล้วเซียนมาก555สนุกด้วยย
items.text_vn: Hồi nhỏ từng chơi rồi, giờ thành cao thủ luôn haha, vui nữa.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi từ nhỏ, khen game vui.
items.text_en: I played as a kid, now I'm a pro haha, and it's fun too.
items.summary_en: Played since childhood; says the game is fun.

items.text_th: เล่นสนุกสอนแล้วเล่นง่ายมากค่ะ
items.text_vn: Chơi vui, có hướng dẫn nên chơi dễ lắm ạ.
items.summary_vn: Khen game vui, có hướng dẫn nên dễ chơi.
items.text_en: Fun to play, there's a tutorial so it's really easy.
items.summary_en: Says the game is fun and easy thanks to the tutorial.
